# SYNESIS_E130 — Warning

## Description

"Label" is both preferred and alternative in `concept_a`.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the preferred label derived from `concept_a` ("Label")
  is also an alternative or hidden label of the same concept (SKOS S13).
  Remove the term from LABEL ALTERNATIVE/HIDDEN or declare a LABEL PREFERRED.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **DerivedLabelOverlap**: `block`, `concept`, `label`
